errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis are not in alphabetical order. The order is: ЛИДЕРСТВО, УПРАВЛЕНИЕ НА ВРЕМЕТО, УМЕНИЯ ЗА ВОДЕНЕ НА..., КОМУНИКАЦИОННИ..., КООРДИНАЦИЯ И..., SUMSS2.
The last category on the x-axis is labeled 'SUMSS2' in the figure, not 'SUM552'. This mistake is repeated twice in the description.
The description claims that the vertical axis has intervals of 0.1. However, the vertical axis is not shown with any tick marks or intervals.
The legend is located at the top center of the chart, not in the top right corner.
